All modules

talk

pages · 0.5.1 · aj-p-talk

Talk: the voice memo. The compact transport recorder (ready), the kept recording with its row and the way back (kept, transcribing), and three microphone drawings kept for the comp (before, denied, missing). One render for every platform; for the kept recording desktop puts the back link in the title block beside the page.
